name: ElevenMusic
desc: Platform for discovering, remixing and creating music with artists
desc_zh: 用来发现、改编和创作音乐，并与音乐人分成的平台
solves: Stock music sounds like stock music, and creators who remix a track earn nothing. ElevenMusic puts listening, remixing and original creation in one place and pays artists when their work is used.
solves_zh: 素材音乐听起来都一个样，改编的人也拿不到分成。ElevenMusic 把听、改编和原创放进同一处，作品被使用时音乐人有收入。
best_for: When a video needs a soundtrack that is not the same library track everyone else licensed.
best_for_zh: 视频需要一首配乐，而不是所有人都授权过的那首素材曲的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ElevenLabs blog index (elevenlabs.io/blog), post "Introducing ElevenMusic"）。 First availability predates the research window (2026-05-07) but the product is absent from the ledger, which lists only the ElevenLabs platform itself. Built with artists, labels and publishers; there is a separate Eleven Music API page. 首次公开日期来源：https://elevenlabs.io/blog/introducing-elevenmusic
